ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (1) Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh,[1681] and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Sabbaḥa lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wahuwal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
en: (2) O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūn

ar: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
en: (3) Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
tr: Kabura maqtan ʿindallāhi an taqūlū mā lā tafʿalūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَٰنٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ
en: (4) Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
tr: Innallāha yuḥibbul-ladhīna yuqātilūna fī sabīlihī ṣaffan kaʾannahum bunyānum marṣūṣ

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓا۟ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
en: (5) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allāh to you?" And when they deviated, Allāh caused their hearts to deviate. And Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
tr: Waʾidh qāla mūsā liqawmihī yāqawmi lima tuʾdhūnanī waqat taʿlamūna annī rasūlullāhi ilaykum, falammā zāghū azāghallāhu qulūbahum, wallāhu lā yahdil-qawmal-fāsiqīn

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (6) And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad."[1682] But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."[1683]
enNotes:
[1682]- Another name of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).
[1683]- i.e., fraud or deception.
tr: Waʾidh qāla ʿīsabnu maryama yābanī isrāʾīla innī rasūlullāhi ilaykum muṣaddiqal limā bayna yadayya minat-tawrāti wamubashshiram birasūliy yaʾtī mim baʿdismuhū aḥmad, falammā jāʾahum bil-bayyināti qālū hādhā siḥrum mubīn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (7) And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhil-kadhiba wahuwa yudʿā ilal-islām, wallāhu lā yahdil-qawmaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (8) They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
tr: Yurīdūna liyuṭfiʾū nūrallāhi biʾafwāhihim, wallāhu mutimmu nūrihī walaw karihal-kāfirūn

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
en: (9) It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.
tr: Huwal-ladhī arsala rasūlahū bil-hudā wadīnil-ḥaqqi liyuẓhirahū ʿalad-dīni kullihī walaw karihal-mushrikūn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَٰرَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: (10) O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū hal adullukum ʿalā tijāratin tunjīkum min ʿadhābin alīm

ar: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (11) [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.
tr: Tuʾminūna billāhi warasūlihī watujāhidūna fī sabīlillāhi biʾamwālikum waʾanfusikum, dhālikum khayrul lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: (12) He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
tr: Yaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wayudkhilkum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru wamasākina ṭayyibatan fī jannāti ʿadn, dhālikal-fawzul-ʿaẓīm

ar: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (13) And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.
tr: Waʾukhrā tuḥibbūnahā, naṣrum minallāhi wafatḥun qarīb, wabashshiril-muʾminīn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَٰهِرِينَ
en: (14) O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū kūnū anṣārallāhi kamā qāla ʿīsabnu maryama lil-ḥawāriyyīna man anṣārī ilallāh, qālal-ḥawāriyyūna naḥnu anṣārullāhi faʾāmanaṭ ṭāʾifatum mim banī isrāʾīla wakafaraṭ ṭāʾifah, faʾayyadnal-ladhīna āmanū ʿalā ʿaduwwihim faʾaṣbaḥū ẓāhirīn
